thread:
nina: Heads up 1 opened a PR to clarify Polarion13B limits in the model catalog. Also added a short example for embedding sharding and a streaming generation SDK snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/845

omar: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) can we call out that the 6k sequence number is for sliding-window decode only (not full-context) and 2) the embed sharding sample needs to show how to reassemble shards on the client side.

sophie: Good catches. For #1 I added a parenthetical: "(sliding-window decoding; full-context max_sequence_length=4096)". For #2 I sketched a small reassembly example using numpy.concatenate in the snippets section.

nina: Nice. Can you paste the reassembly snippet here so I can sanity check?

sophie: Sure:```python
# assume shards = [emb1, emb2, emb3] where each emb is a list of vectors
import numpy as np
full_emb = np.concatenate(shards, axis=0)
# optionally average or pool per original document boundaries
```

omear: tiny nit: we prefer using redwood SDK helpers for embedding merge when possible. Add a one-liner referencing redwood.embeddings.merge_shards() so users discover the helper.

sophie: Ack. Added a call example and link to API reference.

kai: About benchmarks: PR shows throughput numbers for fp16 vs int8-ggml-v2 on a V100 test host. Please note these are non-production microbenchmarks and include warmup config in the CSV header. Add a footnote that memory accounting excludes host-side cache.

nina: Good point. I added a footnote and attached the updated CSV.

omar: The streaming SDK example currently uses the sync client and prints partial chunks. We should switch to AsyncClient.stream_generate for SDKv4 and keep the old sync example behind a collapse/legacy toggle. Also add a one-sentence migration note for customers moving from sync->async.

sophie: Updated the snippet:```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY)
async for chunk in client.stream_generate(model="polarion13b", input="Tell me about X"):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```
And added: "If you previously used the sync client, migrate to AsyncClient and adapt your event loop; see migration guide link."

kai: One more: the compatibility matrix link in the PR was a redirect to an old slug causing a 404 in linkcheck. I fixed the link target and added an internal anchor to the "quantized variants" section.

docs-bot: Linkcheck running for PR #845   docs lint, examples test, anchor-check.

omar: I'd like a short bulleted callout under the "limits" table about real-world memory variance for long-lived sessions (cache + KV). Something like: "Note: long-running chat sessions with KV cache may consume extra memory; plan ~15% above the static numbers."

sophie: Added that line and an example calculation.

nina: LGTM pending CI. Sophie, can you also add a one-sentence blurb for the migration guide: "When switching from fp16 to int8-ggml-v2, validate outputs against a small prompt set; expect small reranking differences due to quantization."

sophie: Done.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #845  merging in 5s.

nina: merged. I'll file a follow-up to add an automated test that asserts presence of SDKv4 streaming examples on all large-model cards.

omar: Thanks all. Quick win.

kai: small celebration emoji :tada:
